instruction: Walk down the red carpet and turn right at the bed.  Stop under the door frame.

steps.thought: The red carpet runs straight ahead through the ornate door frame. I'll advance along it, re-observing as I go.
I'm at the start of the red carpet facing a doorway into the bedroom. I should walk forward along the carpet toward the bed.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the bedroom with the bed visible ahead. I'll advance along the carpet toward the bed before turning right.
I've walked down the red carpet and just entered the bedroom; the bed is on the left. I should advance a bit further to the bed, then turn right to find the door frame to stop under.
I've walked the carpet and turned right at the bed; the door frame is ahead on the right. I'll advance toward it and stop under it.
I'm on the red carpet with the bed on my left. I need to continue along the carpet, then turn right toward the doorway visible on the right wall and stop under that door frame.
I've turned right at the bed and now face an open doorway ahead. I'll advance toward it and stop under the door frame.
I've walked the red carpet and turned at the bed; now a doorway is visible ahead-right. I'll turn right toward it and advance to get under the door frame.
I'm on the red carpet with a doorway visible ahead-right. I'll advance along the carpet toward the door frame, then turn right through it.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the doorway ahead; the bed should be in the next room where I'll turn right. Continue forward along the carpet, checking alignment with the door opening.
The red carpet led me to a corner with an open doorway on the right. I should turn right toward the door frame and move under it.
I'm facing down the red carpet through a doorway, but I haven't passed the bed yet. I'll advance along the carpet and look for the bed to turn right at.
I'm passing through a door frame onto the red carpet, but I haven't seen the bed yet, so the goal door frame is still ahead. Continue along the carpet.

I'm on the red carpet heading toward the ornate door frame at the far end of the room. I should keep advancing along the carpet; the bed turn likely already happened, and the goal is the door frame ahead.
I'm on the red carpet moving toward the ornate door frame ahead. I'll keep advancing along the carpet; the bed/turn should appear as I approach.
I'm on the red carpet with the bed to my left and a door frame ahead. I'll advance along the carpet toward the doorway, then turn right at the bed and stop under the door frame.
I'm on the red carpet facing a doorway ahead; the bed isn't visible yet, so I'll keep advancing along the carpet toward the door frame.
I'm on the red carpet heading toward the door frame at the far end of the room. I'll keep advancing along the carpet toward it.
I'm on the red carpet approaching a doorway ahead; the bed hasn't appeared yet, so I should keep advancing along the carpet toward the door frame.
I'm on the red carpet facing a doorway ahead; the bed isn't visible yet, so I'll keep advancing along the carpet toward the door frame.
I'm on the red carpet approaching a door frame straight ahead. I'll advance a couple steps to get under it, then stop.
I've walked down the red carpet and am now right at a large ornate door frame. The instruction ends at a door frame, so I'll step just under it and stop.
